falsifier.text: XGD.TO gains more than 10% relative to XEG.TO before the check-by date

In a one-narrative tape where capital is concentrating in energy (absorption 0.31), the bottom of the stack has no staying-power argument.

falsifier.text: XRE.TO gains more than 8% while XEG.TO is flat or down over the same period
